nutButter.title: His stamp. His standard.
nutButter.body: From peanut and almond butter to pistachio and mixed nut butter: De Notenman decides what makes the shelf and what quality it must meet. Full of flavour, without unnecessary detours.
nutButter.detail: We look at flavour, texture and what is on the label. If it does not need to be in the jar, it stays out. Simple as that. Spread it on toast, stir it through breakfast, use it in a sauce or eat it straight from the spoon — we still won't tell.
highlights: From peanut and almond to pistachio and mixed nuts
Selected for flavour, texture and ingredients
For toast, breakfast, sauces or the spoon
